checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add Basu 2023 binaural-beats cognition meta-analysis as context and add a new no-binaural-beats claim boundary

impact_assessment.benefits: Adds aave context record and a new claim boundary distinguishing the app from entrainment gimmicks.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Verify via efetch, update records/references/counts/version, add bounded boundary citation with tests, run suites and review UI.
